questions.prompt: In whose vision does "one like the son of man" come with the clouds of heaven to the Ancient of days?
questions.explanation: "I beheld therefore in the vision of the night, and lo, one like the son of man came with the clouds of heaven."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, in whose spirit and power did John go before Jesus?
questions.explanation: Going before Jesus "in the spirit and power of Elijah", John bears witness to Christ in his preaching, by his Baptism of conversion, and through his martyrdom.

questions.prompt: What title does John give Jesus when he sees him coming to him (John 1:29)?
questions.explanation: "Behold the Lamb of God, behold him who taketh away the sin of the world."

questions.prompt: In the Benedictus (Luke 1:76), of what is the child John to be called the prophet?
questions.explanation: "And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, where does Jesus' public life begin, with his baptism by John?
questions.explanation: "Jesus' public life begins with his baptism by John in the Jordan."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, John the Baptist begins the cycle of prophets which Elijah completed.
questions.explanation: No: "John completes the cycle of prophets begun by Elijah."

questions.prompt: In Matthew 17:13, whom did the disciples understand Jesus to mean when he said that Elijah is already come?
questions.explanation: "Then the disciples understood, that he had spoken to them of John the Baptist."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, John's baptism was for repentance, while baptism in water and the Spirit will be a new birth.
questions.explanation: "John's baptism was for repentance; baptism in water and the Spirit will be a new birth."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, how does the Church unite herself to John's desire when she celebrates his birth and martyrdom?
choices: She lights a candle for each of the prophets of old
She repeats his words: "He must increase, but I must decrease."
She keeps a fast of three days before his feast
She sings the Magnificat, as Mary sang it to Elizabeth
questions.correctAnswer: She repeats his words: "He must increase, but I must decrease."
questions.explanation: "By celebrating the precursor's birth and martyrdom, the Church unites herself to his desire: 'He must increase, but I must decrease.'"

questions.prompt: How does the angel Gabriel salute Mary at the Annunciation, according to the Catechism?
questions.explanation: "The angel Gabriel at the moment of the annunciation salutes her as 'full of grace'."

questions.prompt: True or False: Pope Pius XII proclaimed the dogma of the Immaculate Conception in 1854.
questions.explanation: No: it was Pope Pius IX who proclaimed the dogma, in 1854.

questions.prompt: Which solemnity of Mary does the Church celebrate in the heart of Advent, on December 8?
choices: The Annunciation of the Lord to the Blessed Virgin Mary
The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary into heaven
The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary to Elizabeth
questions.correctAnswer: The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
questions.explanation: Marialis Cultus notes that during Advent there are many liturgical references to Mary "besides the Solemnity of December 8", the Immaculate Conception.

questions.prompt: In the Catechism's reflection on the Hail Mary, what is Mary called, "the place where the glory of the Lord dwells"?
choices: The daughter of Zion in person, the ark of the covenant
The new Temple of Solomon, the house of the Lord on Zion
The tabernacle of Moses, the tent of meeting in the desert
The gate of the sheepfold, the door of the house of God
questions.correctAnswer: The daughter of Zion in person, the ark of the covenant
questions.explanation: "Mary, in whom the Lord himself has just made his dwelling, is the daughter of Zion in person, the ark of the covenant, the place where the glory of the Lord dwells."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, the Magnificat is the song both of the Mother of God and of the Church.
questions.explanation: "The Canticle of Mary, the Magnificat ... is the song both of the Mother of God and of the Church."

questions.prompt: In Luke 1:43, who says, "whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?"
questions.explanation: Elizabeth, filled with the Holy Ghost, cried out with a loud voice when Mary visited her.

questions.prompt: According to Marialis Cultus, what does the Advent liturgy present by linking the awaiting of the Messiah and the glorious return of Christ with the commemoration of his Mother?
choices: A reason to omit the saints
questions.explanation: "The Advent liturgy, by linking the awaiting of the Messiah and the awaiting of the glorious return of Christ with the admirable commemoration of His Mother, presents a happy balance in worship."

questions.prompt: According to the Directory, with which Old Testament text should the novena of the Immaculate Conception begin its prophetical readings?
questions.explanation: The novena of the Immaculate Conception "should highlight the prophetical texts which begin with Genesis 3,15, and end in Gabriel's salutation of the one who is 'full of grace'."

citations.reference: Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy 102

questions.prompt: On which date does the General Roman Calendar keep the feast of Saint Andrew, the Apostle?
questions.explanation: The General Roman Calendar lists "30 November: Saint Andrew, Apostle – feast".

questions.prompt: On which date is Saint Francis Xavier, Priest, remembered in the General Roman Calendar?
questions.explanation: "3 December: Saint Francis Xavier, Priest – memorial".

questions.prompt: On which date is Saint Nicholas, Bishop, remembered in the General Roman Calendar?
questions.explanation: "6 December: Saint Nicholas, Bishop – optional memorial".

questions.prompt: On which date is Saint Ambrose, Bishop and Doctor of the Church, remembered?
questions.explanation: "7 December: Saint Ambrose, Bishop and Doctor of the Church – memorial".

questions.prompt: On which date is Saint Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin remembered in the General Roman Calendar?
questions.explanation: "9 December: Saint Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin – optional memorial".

questions.prompt: On which date is Saint Lucy, Virgin and Martyr, remembered?
questions.explanation: "13 December: Saint Lucy, Virgin and Martyr – memorial".

questions.prompt: On which date is Saint John of the Cross, Priest and Doctor of the Church, remembered?
questions.explanation: "14 December: Saint John of the Cross, Priest and Doctor of the Church – memorial".

questions.prompt: Which saint, remembered on December 14, is quoted in the Catechism as commenting strikingly on Hebrews 1:1-2?
questions.explanation: "St. John of the Cross, among others, commented strikingly on Hebrews 1:1-2."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does the disciple do in prayer, "attentive to Him Who Is and Him Who Comes"?
questions.explanation: "In prayer the disciple keeps watch, attentive to Him Who Is and Him Who Comes, in memory of his first coming in the lowliness of the flesh, and in the hope of his second coming in glory."

questions.prompt: "Vigilance is 'custody of the ____'."
questions.explanation: "Vigilance is 'custody of the heart,' and Jesus prayed for us to the Father: 'Keep them in your name.'"

questions.prompt: What does Philippians 4:6 say to do instead of being solicitous?
choices: Give alms to the poor and fast on every day of the week
Fast and keep vigil through the night, in sackcloth and ashes
Wait in silence for a sign from the Lord, with patience
Make your petitions known to God by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving
questions.correctAnswer: Make your petitions known to God by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving
questions.explanation: "Be nothing solicitous; but in every thing, by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your petitions be made known to God."

questions.prompt: According to canon 1250, the penitential days and times in the universal Church are every Friday of the whole year and the season of ____.
questions.explanation: "The penitential days and times in the universal Church are every Friday of the whole year and the season of Lent." Advent is not named.

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what is the condition for entering the kingdom?
choices: To fast for forty days in the wilderness
To become a child in relation to God
To build a house for the name of the Lord
To know the day and hour of the Lord's coming
questions.correctAnswer: To become a child in relation to God
questions.explanation: "To become a child in relation to God is the condition for entering the kingdom. For this, we must humble ourselves and become little."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, the Holy Spirit constantly seeks to awaken us to keep watch.
questions.explanation: "The Holy Spirit constantly seeks to awaken us to keep watch."

questions.prompt: According to the saying in CCC 1691, what should a Christian never forget?
choices: That he has been rescued from the power of darkness and brought into the light of the Kingdom of God
That he must not judge anyone, since only the Father knows the day and hour
That the world will soon pass away and that he must prepare for the end of all things
That the Law was given on Sinai to Moses and that he must keep it faithfully
questions.correctAnswer: That he has been rescued from the power of darkness and brought into the light of the Kingdom of God
questions.explanation: "Never forget that you have been rescued from the power of darkness and brought into the light of the Kingdom of God."

questions.prompt: According to Matthew 25:13, why must we watch?
choices: Because you know not the day nor the hour
Because the prophets are silent and the Temple will fall
Because the Lord has already come and has gone away
Because the harvest is ready and the laborers are few
questions.correctAnswer: Because you know not the day nor the hour
questions.explanation: "Watch ye therefore, because you know not the day nor the hour."
